dx: Adénocarcinome de la vésicule avec foyers satellites
pair_match: Scanner : adénocarcinome de la vésicule biliaire avec foyers satellites (légende source). Contrôle visuel du 28.11.2026 : épaississement tumoral vésiculaire et nodules hépatiques satellites.

patho.author: Hellerhoff
patho.caption_source: Adenocarcinoma of the gallbladder with satellite foci in the liver, which, like the primarius, which develops from the stone-filled gallbladder and spreads to the liver, appear centrally hypodense and hyperattenuating peripheral rim. Top images are axial arterial and portal venous. Bottom images are coronal and sagittal portal venous.
